identity_studies.detailed_concept: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a transparent-background 16-bit fantasy tactical RPG character design sheet, 2 columns by 2 rows, four equal cells. NEW elite mechanical puppet called Pseudo Titan. A massive but compact bipedal artificial guardian, heavy barrel torso, very broad shoulder plates, large articulated empty metal fists, short thick armored legs, hunched deliberate stance. Ancient harbor military automaton, NOT a living human or stone monster. Worn old brass structural bands and rivets, slate blue-gray armor plates, charcoal hinge joints, ivory ceramic small mask set low between shoulders, two narrow pale cyan eyes. A highly readable circular PROTECTIVE CORE inset in the CENTER OF THE CHEST: turquoise glass center with concentric brass iris segments and two short pale cyan conduits to shoulders. Core is the only light accent, restrained pixels, NOT an aura. Rear has a closed round brass maintenance housing and the same structural braces; no second chest orb on back. Heavy mechanical craftsmanship visually related to an old-brass and slate-blue monkey automaton but a completely distinct giant guardian body, no monkey traits. No weapon, no cannon, no wings, no horns, no extra arms, no magic beams. Body approximately one and a half ordinary soldier heights at eventual game scale, not skyscraper proportions. Strong compact readable silhouette, beautiful clean controlled pixel clusters, dark contour, limited coherent palette, subtle worn edge highlights, no painterly blur, no photorealism, no 3D render. Top-left: three-quarter FRONT facing LEFT, whole body with core visible. Top-right: three-quarter REAR facing RIGHT. Bottom-left: exact FRONT. Bottom-right: exact REAR. Consistent identity, proportions and apparatus across all four. Entire character fully contained with generous 12% transparent margins in every cell, soles aligned within each row. True alpha transparency outside silhouettes. No text, labels, grid lines, ground, drop shadows, checkerboard, gradients or background.
identity_studies.detailed_battle: Use case: stylized-concept. Use the attached character design as IDENTITY REFERENCE, not an edit target. Produce a new true-transparent pixel-art BATTLE ANIMATION pose atlas for this exact old-brass and slate-blue heavy guardian, ivory mask, big fists, short armored legs, distinctive circular turquoise CHEST protective core. Exact regular FOUR COLUMNS x FOUR ROWS, 16 equal cells, every entire body independently isolated, oriented THREE-QUARTER FRONT facing LEFT. All soles baseline aligned per row, same body size across all frames. IMPORTANT: shrink each figure enough to have at least 14 percent clean transparent margin on all sides of every cell; no limb or debris near edges. Refined 16-bit tactical RPG sprite look, precise pixel clusters, dark outlines, controlled subtle armor wear. No labels, cell outlines, shadows, floor or backgrounds. Core glow is restrained readable cyan, no aura. No weapons, no cannon. TOP TWO ROWS are CORE INTACT with turquoise core and glowing two short shoulder conduits. Row1 left to right: 1) neutral heavy idle standing with lowered fists; 2) marching step left leg planted front, right heel up, arms counter-swing; 3) marching passing pose, legs closer, weight high; 4) marching opposite step right leg front, left heel up, arms counter-swing. Row2: 1) second passing pose in heavy stride, other knee forward; 2) hammer-fist WINDUP, one huge fist drawn back above shoulder, other arm balances, feet planted; 3) single powerful FORWARD-DOWNWARD hammer-fist strike to the LEFT at an invisible soldier's torso height, shoulders tilted, one fist fully extended left, NO impact effect; 4) follow-through and recovery, fist lowered forward and weight settled. BOTTOM TWO ROWS repeat THE SAME EIGHT poses in THE SAME ORDER, BUT CORE DESTROYED: round chest glass smashed open into a large dark jagged socket, lower brass iris segment broken, two short shoulder conduits visibly snapped and dark. A few pieces remain attached, no loose floating debris. Dark inactive chest socket clearly readable at small game scale. No cyan chest glow, NO working conduits, same white mask and pale eyes. Every broken-state pose retains this exact persistent break, not just idle. Damage to core does NOT damage arms/legs or shrink body. Underlying mechanical body, fists, body scale and identity must match upper intact rows. Preserve whole feet and fists fully in each cell. No additional effect sprites or other characters.
identity_studies.pixel_mask_study: Use case: style-transfer. Reinterpret the attached Pseudo Titan four-view design as AUTHENTIC LOW-RESOLUTION GAME PIXEL ART for a mobile tactical RPG. Keep the same old-brass, slate-blue giant automaton identity, ivory mask, round turquoise chest core, empty massive fists, round rear maintenance plate. Keep four views in a regular 2x2 sheet. This is NOT an illustration with a pixel filter. Design EACH whole-body figure on an underlying 72 by 72 pixel grid, as if drawn directly pixel by pixel, then show those pixels enlarged 7 times with nearest-neighbor. Visibly LARGE SQUARE PIXEL CLUSTERS and stair-step silhouette edges. About 20 opaque palette colors TOTAL across the sheet: 3 blue-gray armor shades, 3 brass shades, dark graphite outline and joints, 2 ivory shades, 3 turquoise core shades and a few shared supporting tones. Broad clean planes, 2–3 flat tonal steps per material. No dithering, NO tiny speckled scratches, NO individual micro-rivets, NO continuous gradients, NO painted texture, NO anti-aliasing, NO soft lighting, no blur. A fist is a readable compact 8x9 pixel mass, ivory mask about 5x7 pixels, chest core about 8x8 pixels. Preserve shape readability on an actual phone screen at original logical size. The four figures must be complete and comfortably fit INSIDE each quadrant with at least 10 percent transparent margin around all fists and feet. Top-left three-quarter front facing LEFT; top-right three-quarter rear facing RIGHT; bottom-left exact front; bottom-right exact rear. Same height and structure in all views. Core is restrained turquoise when seen from front; rear is closed metal without another glowing orb. True transparent background. No labels, text, grids, extra characters, shadow or floor.
